Quiet strengths of men raised
without a dad

1. He plans everything.

Nobody had a plan for him.

2. He figures things out.

Trial, error, repeat.

3. He shows up for kids.

Every game. Every recital.

4. He's calm under pressure.

He learned it early.

5. He's a lifelong learner.

He taught himself everything.
